newsitem.title: UK: Scottish Mutual '96 new premium business up.
newsitem.headline: Scottish Mutual '96 new premium business up.

text.p: Britain's Abbey National Plc said on Friday that total new premium business at its Scottish Mutual Assurance Plc unit grew 81 percent to 919 million stg in 1996.
The unit's annualised new premium business grew 58 percent to 131 million stg, while total new annual life and pensions business rose by 22 percent to 44 million stg.
Total new single life and pensions business increased to 875 million stg from 470 million stg.
Within that figure, single life premiums jumped to 571 million from 131 million stg, the firm said in a statement.
